text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's my birthday. Join me for a meal once 
in a while, Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I'll pass. The spectators are gonna be 
noisy anyway, right? I'm sick of crazy 
parties.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Still, how about just the two of us then?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We're roommates, after all. ...I'll give 
you some special tender loving care, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a massive hook you're 
dangling. I'm not biting unless the payout 
matches.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Unless, of course, there's a 'special' 
return worthy of making me go all-in on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not very endearing, are ya? Refusing 
to take the bait so easily, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, well... unlike the others, you 
don't take the bait so easily. That's what 
makes you fun.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't go getting reeled in by any other 
small fry from now on, got it?
